key_insight: The paper introduces a conservative local grid-refinement strategy for vectorial lattice Boltzmann methods that preserves mass, momentum, and energy exactly across coarse-fine interfaces.
engineering_relevance: This enables efficient multiscale CFD simulations by refining only where needed while maintaining strict conservation and compatibility with arbitrary equations of state.
method: Shared-link-speed coarse and fine grids with sub-cycling at a fixed time-step ratio
Mean-preserving temporal reconstruction provides coarse-to-fine boundary data
Berger-Colella-style reflux and conservative split/merge AMR operators ensure exact conservation
evidence_signal: The method is validated on a sequence of increasingly demanding 2D test cases, showing exact conservation and improved accuracy relative to an equivalent uniform grid.
watch_item: Implementation must carefully synchronize sub-cycling, temporal reconstruction, and reflux bookkeeping to avoid conservation errors at refinement interfaces.
paper_title: Conservative local grid refinement for the vectorial lattice Boltzmann method
